whatIs.title: What is the car installment calculator?
whatIs.description: Enter price, options, discount, down payment, term and rate to get the monthly payment, total interest and total cost including acquisition tax. It also handles balloon (deferred) installments and compares terms, down payments, and standard vs balloon plans side by side.

howToUse.title: How to use
items: Enter the car price (incl. VAT), options and discount to set the purchase price.
Set the down payment as a percent or amount, the term (12–60 months) and the annual rate from your quote.
For a balloon plan, choose 'Balloon' and set the balloon percentage; the amount due at maturity is shown.
Add other upfront costs from your quote (bonds, plates, delivery) to include them in cash at delivery and total cost.
Tap a cell in the comparison table to apply it, and share the result as a link or image.

tips.title: Tips
items: Rates differ by credit, maker promotions and lender. Enter rates from 2–3 quotes to compare total interest.
A longer term lowers the monthly payment but raises total interest — check 36/48/60 months in the table.
Balloon plans look cheaper monthly, but the balloon accrues interest every month and must be repaid at once.
Look beyond the payment: add insurance and fuel and check the total against your income.

items.q: How is a balloon installment calculated?
items.a: You pay only interest on the balloon throughout the term and repay it in full at maturity; the rest is repaid in equal installments. Monthly payments drop but total interest rises. Whether the balloon can be refinanced at maturity depends on the lender.

items.q: Is there an early repayment fee?
items.a: The rate and period are set by your contract, and some products have none. Under Korea's Financial Consumer Protection Act, no early repayment fee may be charged once 3 years have passed since the loan (including installment finance) contract.

With installment finance, a finance company pays the dealer and you repay it over time. With an auto loan you borrow from a bank or card company (or pay by card and split it). Pricing, liens and perks vary by product, so compare total interest for the same amount and term.

Non-commercial passenger cars: 7% of the supply value (purchase price ÷ 1.1); compact cars: 4%. Compact cars get up to ₩750,000 exempted, EVs up to ₩1,400,000 for acquisitions through Dec 31, 2026 and hydrogen cars through Dec 31, 2027 (a government bill before the National Assembly would cut the EV cap to ₩700,000 from 2027). Regional bonds, plates and stamp duty are extra.

items.q: What is a typical car installment rate?
items.a: It varies widely by credit, new vs used, maker promotions and lender, so there is no single number. The legal maximum is 20% per year. Enter the rate on your quote.

items.q: Can I compare leases or rentals?
items.a: Lease and rental quotes depend on residual value, insurance, taxes and maintenance, so this calculator does not estimate them. Compare the quote's total (monthly fee × months + non-refundable deposit + buyout if any) with the total cost here.
